result.Method of Attack: Persistence via GSocket reverse shell and SystemD/rc.local/crontab; Memory-based evasion using memfd_create() syscall for in-memory execution; Rootkit injection via /etc/ld.so.preload (alamdar.so) to hide processes and files; Cryptojacking using UPX-packed XMRig Monero miner; Proxyjacking using IPRoyal Pawns client (hezb.x86_64); Command and control via multi-tier C2 infrastructure including GSocket network; Propagation via SSH brute force using harvested keys and scanning local subnet; Exploitation of PHP-FPM command injection vulnerability in Magento CMS plugin; Malicious Docker container spawning via Docker Engine API exploitation
Attack Vector: PHP-FPM command injection via Magento CMS plugin
Malicious Docker container creation via Docker Engine API
SSH brute force using harvested known_hosts and SSH config keys
Persistence scripts executed via cron jobs and system services
Memory-resident payload execution to evade detection
